description: This Python source file provides image processing utilities for detection, conversion, and matching tasks, including functions for converting images between formats, performing non-maximum suppression, multi-scale template matching, feature-based detection, and drawing detection boxes.

classes.name: Detection

methods.description: Performs non-maximum suppression on detection boxes based on IoU and center distance thresholds.

methods.description: Uses feature matching with homography to detect templates with rotation support as a fallback method.

methods.description: Draws detection boxes on an image for visualization.
